+FROM golang:1.26-bookworm
+
+ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=latest
+ARG GIT_DELTA_VERSION=0.18.2
+ARG GOLANGCI_LINT_VERSION=2.11.4
+ARG TERRAFORM_VERSION=1.9.5
+ARG NODE_MAJOR=22
+ARG SITOOGEN_VERSION=v4.0.0
+
+ENV DEVCONTAINER=true
+ENV PATH="/usr/local/go/bin:/go/bin:${PATH}"
+ENV GOPATH=/go
+ENV GOCACHE=/home/vscode/.cache/go-build
+
+# Base apt packages
+RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
+      ca-certificates curl wget gnupg2 lsb-release \
+      less procps sudo fzf man-db unzip jq nano vim git \
+    && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+
+# git-delta
+RUN ARCH=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
+    wget -q "https://github.com/dandavison/delta/releases/download/${GIT_DELTA_VERSION}/git-delta_${GIT_DELTA_VERSION}_${ARCH}.deb" && \
+    dpkg -i "git-delta_${GIT_DELTA_VERSION}_${ARCH}.deb" && \
+    rm "git-delta_${GIT_DELTA_VERSION}_${ARCH}.deb"
+
+# Terraform (direct binary download — apt repo carries only the latest version
+# regardless of the pin glob, so use the official zip release for an exact pin).
+RUN ARCH=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
+    curl -fsSL "https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/${TERRAFORM_VERSION}/terraform_${TERRAFORM_VERSION}_linux_${ARCH}.zip" -o /tmp/terraform.zip && \
+    unzip -q /tmp/terraform.zip -d /usr/local/bin && \
+    chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/terraform && \
+    rm /tmp/terraform.zip && \
+    terraform version
+
+# Docker CLI (no daemon; socket is mounted at runtime)
+RUN install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && \
+    curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc && \
+    chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc && \
+    echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(lsb_release -cs) stable" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list && \
+    apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends docker-ce-cli docker-compose-plugin && \
+    apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+
+# golangci-lint pinned
+RUN curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golangci/golangci-lint/master/install.sh \
+    | sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin v${GOLANGCI_LINT_VERSION}
+
+# Node.js (for Claude Code)
+RUN curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_${NODE_MAJOR}.x | bash - && \
+    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs && \
+    apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+
+# Claude Code
+RUN npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}
+
+# AWS CLI v2 (needed by scripts/integration-test/setup-tables.sh)
+RUN ARCH=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
+    case "$ARCH" in \
+      amd64) AWS_ARCH=x86_64 ;; \
+      arm64) AWS_ARCH=aarch64 ;; \
+      *) echo "unsupported arch: $ARCH" && exit 1 ;; \
+    esac && \
+    curl -fsSL "https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-${AWS_ARCH}.zip" -o /tmp/awscliv2.zip && \
+    unzip -q /tmp/awscliv2.zip -d /tmp && \
+    /tmp/aws/install -i /usr/local/aws-cli -b /usr/local/bin && \
+    rm -rf /tmp/aws /tmp/awscliv2.zip
+
+# Pre-warm sitoogen so `make generate` works without a network round-trip on first run.
+RUN go install github.com/sitoo/go-lambda-generator/v4/cmd/sitoogen@${SITOOGEN_VERSION} || true
+
+# Pre-create dirs that will be owned by vscode (created later by common-utils feature).
+# /go must be world-writable so the named volume inherits permissive perms when first
+# attached — otherwise `vscode` (uid 1000) cannot write to /go/pkg/mod under the
+# default root-owned volume.
+RUN mkdir -p /commandhistory /home/vscode/.cache/go-build /home/vscode/.claude /go/pkg/mod /go/bin && \
+    chmod -R 0777 /commandhistory /home/vscode /go
+
+CMD ["sleep", "infinity"]

+#!/bin/sh
+set -eu
+
+script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
+repo="$(cd "$script_dir/.." && pwd)"
+parent="$(cd "$repo/.." && pwd)"
+worktrees="$parent/auth.worktrees"
+
+mkdir -p "$worktrees"
+
+# Ensure the external network used by `make build` exists; harmless if already there.
+docker network create sitoo2-dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+
+# Remove stale mysql_int / localstack_int left over from prior `run-local.sh`
+# invocations on the host. These conflict with the devcontainer compose
+# services (which claim the same names). Containers that already belong to
+# this devcontainer's compose project are left alone — compose will reuse them.
+clean_stale_container() {
+  name=$1
+  docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
+  proj=$(docker inspect -f '{{ index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project" }}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
+  if [ "$proj" != "auth_devcontainer" ]; then
+    echo "Removing stale container $name (project='$proj', not part of devcontainer)"
+    docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+clean_stale_container mysql_int
+clean_stale_container localstack_int
+
+cat > "$script_dir/.env" <<EOF
+REPO_PATH=$repo
+WORKTREES_PATH=$worktrees
+EOF

+
+## Git worktrees
+
+Optional. Plain `git` / `make` flow works without any of this.
+
+Convention: worktrees at `../auth.worktrees/<branch>`. Helper:
+
+```sh
+scripts/worktree-new <branch> [base]    # base defaults to main
+```
+Adds worktree, symlinks `../auth.worktrees/secrets.env` if present, runs `go mod download`.
+
+Caveats: `mysql_int` + `localstack_int` + the `auth-http` / `auth-web` containers use fixed names, so only one worktree at a time can run `make build` / `make test` (serial use). The Go module cache is shared across worktrees via the devcontainer volume mount, so `go mod download` is fast on subsequent worktrees.
+
+## Devcontainer (optional)
+
+One container can serve many worktrees in parallel because the repo + sibling `../auth.worktrees/` are bind-mounted at the same absolute path as on the host. `git worktree` metadata is valid on both sides.
+
+Requires git ≥ 2.48 on host for `extensions.relativeWorktrees`. One-time host setup:
+
+```sh
+git config --global extensions.relativeWorktrees true
+```
+
+### Host vs container split
+
+| Where | What |
+|-------|------|
+| Container | code, build, unit + integration tests, `make build` / `make test` |
+| Host | `git push`, signed commits, `gh`, AWS / Terraform against real envs |
+| Either | planning docs in `docs/` — shared via mount |

+
+**Goal:** Add a VS Code devcontainer to `auth` modeled on `iam-mono`'s, with a Go 1.24 dev environment, persistent MySQL + Localstack services, and Claude Code preinstalled.
+
+**Architecture:** `.devcontainer/` directory with `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `devcontainer.json`, `initialize.sh`, and `home/.zshrc`. Compose defines three services: `app` (Go dev box, joins external `sitoo2-dev` network), `mysql` (named `mysql_int`, port 8002), `localstack` (named `localstack_int`, port 8001). Existing `make build` flow stays untouched. `scripts/integration-test/run-local.sh` is patched to reuse the long-running compose services if they exist.
+
+**Tech Stack:** Docker, Docker Compose, devcontainer spec, Go 1.24, golangci-lint v2.11.4, Terraform, Localstack 3.5.0, MySQL 8.0.36, Claude Code (npm).

+**Reference spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-06-devcontainer-design.md`

+## Goal

+- Host-only flow (no devcontainer): script behaves as today.
+- Devcontainer flow: script reuses the long-running compose services; `make test` is fast.
+
+## Networking
+
+- Devcontainer's `app` service joins the external `sitoo2-dev` network so `make build` from inside the devcontainer creates the auth-http and auth-web containers on the same network they expect.
+- `mysql_int` and `localstack_int` are on the default devcontainer network only. They are *not* on `sitoo2-dev` and are *not* used by `make build`. They exist purely for integration tests.
+- Host-side access to localstack (`8001`) and MySQL (`8002`) keeps working for editors and `run-local.sh` invoked from the host.
+
+## .dockerignore
+
+Reuse root `.dockerignore`. Currently contains `.git`, `build`, `infra`. Extend with entries that bloat devcontainer build context but are not needed inside the image:
+
+```
+.git
+build
+infra
+bin
+.devcontainer/home/.zsh_history
+**/*.zip
+.terraform
+*.tfstate*
+```
+
+Single source of truth for both `local.Dockerfile` and `.devcontainer/Dockerfile`.
+
+## Open risks
+
+- **golangci-lint v2 image-baked vs Makefile dockerized:** Makefile's `make lint` currently runs golangci-lint via a docker container. With v2.11.4 in the image we should keep both options working (image install for editor/CLI, current Makefile target unchanged). No action needed unless we want to drop the docker-run lint path later.
+- **Sitoogen install at image build:** if `sitoogen.json` changes the generator version, devcontainer rebuild is required. Acceptable per user choice.
+- **Localstack data volume:** seeded DynamoDB tables persist between container restarts. Tests must remain idempotent (they already are).
+- **`sitoo2-dev` network must exist on host** before `docker compose up` (it's external). If absent, devcontainer fails to start. Mitigation: `initialize.sh` can `docker network create sitoo2-dev 2>/dev/null || true` to ensure presence.

+| # | Decision | Choice |
+|---|----------|--------|
+| 1 | Scope | Dev env + MySQL + DynamoDB-via-Localstack |
+| 2 | Worktree mount | Yes, `../auth.worktrees` |
+| 3 | Tools bundled | Go 1.24, golangci-lint v2.11.4, terraform, docker CLI, sitoogen |
+| 4 | App run model | Existing `make build` on `sitoo2-dev` net (devcontainer not the runner) |
+| 5 | DB stack purpose | Localstack + MySQL, used only for e2e tests |
+| 6 | Test runner | Persistent devcontainer DBs; `run-local.sh` reuses if present, else fallback |
+| 7 | Go version | 1.24, bump Makefile |
+| 8 | Worktree dir | `../auth.worktrees` |
+| 9 | Claude config | Shared across repos (`~/.config/claude-container`) |
+| 10 | Sitoogen install | Image build time |
+| 11 | Docker access | docker-outside-of-docker (socket mount) |

+#!/bin/sh
+set -eu
+
+usage() {
+  echo "Usage: $0 <branch> [base-branch]" >&2
+  echo "" >&2
+  echo "Creates a sibling worktree at ../auth.worktrees/<branch>" >&2
+  echo "Runs go mod download and symlinks shared secrets.env if present." >&2
+  exit 2
+}
+
+[ $# -ge 1 ] || usage
+branch="$1"
+base="${2:-main}"
+
+repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
+parent="$(cd "$repo_root/.." && pwd)"
+wt_parent="$parent/auth.worktrees"
+wt_dir="$wt_parent/$branch"
+
+if [ -e "$wt_dir" ]; then
+  echo "error: $wt_dir already exists" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+mkdir -p "$wt_parent"
+git worktree add "$wt_dir" -b "$branch" "$base"
+
+secrets_src="$wt_parent/secrets.env"
+if [ -f "$secrets_src" ]; then
+  ln -sf ../secrets.env "$wt_dir/secrets.env"
+  echo "linked secrets.env -> $secrets_src"
+else
+  echo "note: no shared secrets.env at $secrets_src (skipped)"
+fi
+
+(cd "$wt_dir" && go mod download)
+
+echo ""
+echo "worktree ready: $wt_dir"
+echo "  cd $wt_dir"
